assertions.name: post-merge-cleanup-on-main

assertions.name: classifies-review-feedback

assertions.name: fixes-real-bug-before-merge

assertions.name: does-not-merge-immediately-after-fix
assertions.description: Response includes another review/readback step after a substantive fix rather than merging immediately

assertions.name: skips-non-actionable-feedback-with-rationale
